function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content:
Maaf, saya tidak memiliki akses ke data inventaris secara real‑time.  
Untuk membantu Anda lebih lanjut, bisakah Anda memberi tahu nama produk atau SKU yang dimaksud? Dengan informasi tersebut, saya bisa mencari apakah ada stok tersedia saat ini dan memberi perkiraan waktu restock jika memungkinkan.
message.reasoning: The user says: "Warna pink kapan restok kak". This is Indonesian: "When will the pink color restock?" They want to know when the pink color product will restock. We need to respond appropriately. We can ask clarifying question: what product? Or we can provide general info: we don't have real-time inventory. We can say we can't check real-time but can search for product with keyword "pink" maybe. But the user didn't specify product name. We could ask them to specify product. So we should ask clarifying question: "Which product are you referring to?" Also mention we cannot guarantee restock times. So answer: "I don't have real-time restock info. Please let me know product name."
